task.title: Extract source-grounded contract clauses
task.instructions: Return only a JSON object with clauses and abstained. Each clause has clause_type (renewal or termination), text (the exact source sentence), start (zero-based character offset), and end (exclusive character offset). Include both types when both appear. Do not invent clauses. When neither type appears, return an empty clauses array and abstained true. Otherwise abstained is false. No markdown or explanation.
